text: Access and security - Publisher reports community resistance blocking safe burials in one Nord-Ubangi zone and slowing decontamination in Isiro; a mobility problem preventing burials in the other Nord-Ubangi zone; in Nord-Ubangi no fixed water point or dedicated latrines and showers at one site, insufficient protective materials and no triage at another; in Bas-Uele laboratory overheating, no cold chain and no computers or connectivity, and a marked slowdown of psychosocial support; in Tshopo a near-stockout of laboratory consumables and a need for more motorcycles; and in Nord-Kivu one control point out of service after a security incident. Nord-Kivu reports 55 of 59 rings opened (93.2%), 22 of 23 health facilities decontaminated (95.7%) and 10 of 32 households given targeted disinfection. No intervention effect is established.
